historicalAssets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original youthful Chi Bi / SHJ-044 character depicted in TWO coherent views: front on the left, three-quarter on the right. True alpha-transparent background.
The TWO input PNGs are the direct drawing-style masters. Strictly use their near-black variable-width contours, sparse internal linework, warm peach HUMAN facial skin, simplified hair masses, clear matte flat colors and hard-edged cel shadows. Use flat dark wine-red irises and solid black pupils, NO eye catchlights, no iris texture or gradients. Preserve expressive eyebrows and mouth tension. Do not copy the reference identities, brown bob, black spiky hairstyle, goggles or clothes. No painterly commercial game rendering, soft lighting, glossy hair, neon glow or feather etching.
Character: Yin / 殷, a handsome 22-year-old male village fire-watch runner, lean youthful body and slightly long oval face. Confident raised left brow and crooked open grin, alert eyes; not a scowling or calm generic face. Short swept-back dark crimson hair with a broad pale amber forelock, clean dark undercut at the sides, NOT a chin-length bob or tall crest. Two ordinary human ears only, no extra animal ears. Different facial structure and haircut from the existing sheep boy and black-feather girl.
Organic yokai anatomy: real deep brick-red and scarlet plumage grows directly from his neck sides across his bare shoulder caps and upper chest, with visible feather-to-skin boundary. Real compact red flight-feather blades grow from the OUTER edges of his two human forearms; keep the two human hands visible. These are skin-grown bird feathers, NOT detachable shoulder armor, feather cape, feather fan, sleeves or costume badges. A single compact pheasant-like tail of a few broad dark-red feathers with muted deep green tips grows naturally from his lower back and is clearly visible beside the hip in both views, with its organic base visible in the three-quarter view. Keep only one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and one tail per figure. No horns, extra arms, extra wings, bird masks or animal face.
Clothing: sleeveless off-white short wrap tunic with charcoal edging that leaves the naturally feathered shoulders exposed, deep moss-green cloth waist sash tied simply, cropped charcoal trousers and plain dark-brown ankle shoes. Clothing is understated so actual red feather anatomy carries the theme. No jewelry, crown, emblem, elaborate armor or weapon.
Composition: two complete full-body figures, front and 35-degree three-quarter, same identity and exact clothing and feather palette. One hand placed loosely at waist and the other relaxed. Leave generous 7% clear margin around every head, hand, shoe and tail tip. Every appendage stays inside the image. Do not overlap the figures. Keep feather shapes broad and few, like the simple flat color masses in the supplied portraits.
This is an original humanized RED BIRD, not a canonical phoenix reconstruction. No phoenix crown, flaming wings, fantasy fire effects, halo, mythic labels or text. No numbered diagrams, captions, scenery, floor shadows or glow. Transparent empty background only.
historicalAssets.iterationNote: First generation has 1px top hair and bottom shoe margins at alpha >=128; the right tail has 30px margin. Retained as tight-framing history. R02 increases all margins without changing identity.

Subject: Tiao of Fuyu mountain / 條（符禺山葵狀）, an ORIGINAL beautiful 21-year-old female red-bloom route adjudicator. Youthful heart-shaped face with wider cheeks and pointed chin; short deep aubergine hair in a curved blunt pageboy with a triangular straight fringe (clearly unlike the reference bob). Flat ochre eyes, one eyebrow cocked high and the other lowered, mouth open in a witty dismissive retort. Fully clothed cream high-neck underlayer, muted plum wrap coat with mustard cuff edging and a dark olive plain waist sash; broad simple cloth blocks and minimal folds.
Actual plant body: BOTH ears are living rounded shallowly lobed green mallow-like leaves with a very simple radial vein structure, growing directly from the sides of her head in place of human ears; no extra human pinnae. On her exposed neck-to-shoulder junction grow two short living green stems that visibly emerge from the skin, each ending in a red flower with a few broad simple petals. Her visible forearms transition into living pale-green stems near the wrists. One forearm has a short attached stem bearing TWO yellow elongated soft rounded tongue-shaped fruits, clearly botanical pods, not literal human tongues, not lanterns or jewelry. Place one forearm across waist and other hand open beside torso so BOTH the red organic blossoms and yellow fruits can be identified in both views. Human hands end in five tidy fingers, no extra limbs. Flowers and pods belong to her body, no detached ornaments.
Source boundary: this is specifically the Fuyu mountain Tiao, described as mallow-like with red flowers and yellow fruits compared with an infant tongue. Do NOT confuse with the Shicui mountain same-name herb with white flowers and black fruit. Rounded leaf morphology, young woman identity, green skin transitions, exact flower/pod configuration and job are original design translations. No white flowers or black fruit. Keep foliage extremely simplified, strong flat shapes and near-black outlines; no delicate game-painting glitter, no glamour makeup.
